test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/729f4d1ebe4adf3dcf086804669b4fd7cafa3394058fb0e5d97879656843519a.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) In the every next figures are getting rotated 90º in anti-clockwise direction.

2) One leaf is added in each figure starting from Left then right alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74677d60699b1a2bf47500df43c6ceb4467492f9ff91b1d56179f3722999e4f8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
